name: BucketLevelPermissions
description: Provides information about the bucket-level permissions settings for an S3 bucket.

allOf.description: The permissions settings of the access control list (ACL) for the bucket. This value is null if an ACL hasn't been defined for the bucket.
The block public access settings for the bucket.
The permissions settings of the bucket policy for the bucket. This value is null if a bucket policy hasn't been defined for the bucket.
